_comment: The canonical id list for this org. refresh-metrics.sh reads ids from here and never re-derives them from the catalog, so a marketplace rename cannot silently drop a row. Order is display order in the README.

plugins.name: Bazaar
plugins.pitch: The plugin marketplace itself, in the bar. Search 2,000+ listings, read a plugin's detail, and copy its install command without opening a browser.

plugins.name: Pit Wall
plugins.pitch: The Formula 1 race weekend on the bar. Countdown to the next session, live timing during one, and the pill goes quiet between race weekends.

plugins.name: Wait State
plugins.pitch: Linux PSI pressure stall information in the bar. Shows when the machine is stalled on IO, memory or CPU, which load average cannot tell you.

plugins.name: MLB Booth
plugins.pitch: Live baseball on the bar. Score, half inning, base state and count for the game you follow, collapsing to nothing on an off day.

plugins.name: X Files
plugins.pitch: The replies to your own X posts, read from the desktop. A drainable queue so a conversation does not get lost in the feed.

plugins.name: Docket
plugins.pitch: The GitHub pull requests actually waiting on you, as a queue. Review requests and your own PRs with a changed state, not a notification firehose.

plugins.name: Crew Chief
plugins.pitch: Which of your AI coding agent sessions is blocked on you. Reads session state across running agents so a waiting prompt does not sit unseen.

plugins.name: Listening Post
plugins.pitch: A curated AI vendor release radar. Model releases, pricing changes and status incidents from 29 sources, in four lanes, quiet when nothing shipped.

plugins.name: Desk Transition
plugins.pitch: Safe local monitor scenes for changing display arrangements and returning focus to the laptop panel without memorizing Hyprland commands.

plugins.name: Foundry
plugins.pitch: Turn a product idea into a governed Omarchy plugin workspace with deliberate scaffolding, validation, and an evidence-first path to submission.

plugins.name: Loose Ends
plugins.pitch: A private local queue for small commitments that are easy to lose between work sessions, with fast capture and deliberate clearing.

plugins.name: Capture Conveyor
plugins.pitch: A local capture lane that turns a quick thought into a deliberate next destination without opening a project manager or browser.

plugins.name: Workspace Storyboard
plugins.pitch: See the work held by each Hyprland workspace, jump to one, and follow a local re-entry trail when the desktop context gets scattered.

plugins.name: Quiet Queue
plugins.pitch: Start a deliberate focus interval that owns Do Not Disturb only while the session is active, then restores the prior notification state.

plugins.name: Flow Boundary
plugins.pitch: A private local ritual for marking intentional starts and stops, with visible FLOW or PAUSE state and a short transition history.

template.pitch: The skeleton every entry above is built from. BarWidget, Panel, a node-testable Model.js, the 12-gate pre-submit lane and CI, so a new widget starts already passing.
